<parameter=code>
def yellow_pieces(fr):
    res=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='Y':
            bb=n['boundary']; rmin=min(p[0] for p in bb); rmax=max(p[0] for p in bb)
            cmin=min(p[1] for p in bb); cmax=max(p[1] for p in bb)
            res.append((rmin,rmax,cmin,cmax,n['pixels']))
    return sorted(res)
def kh(fr):
    tops={}; stems={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        bb=n['boundary']; rmin=min(p[0] for p in bb); rmax=max(p[0] for p in bb)
        cmin=min(p[1] for p in bb); cmax=max(p[1] for p in bb)
        if rmin==42 and rmax==42 and (cmax-cmin)==2: tops[(cmin+cmax)//2]=n['color']
        if 44<=rmin and rmax<=46 and (cmax-cmin)==0: stems[cmin]=n['color']
    return [ (tops.get(x),stems.get(x)) for x in [21,26,31,36,41]]
print('arch/U before:', yellow_pieces(current_frame))
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':54,'col':32}])
print('nframes:', frame_sequence.count)
for i,s in enumerate(frame_sequence.summaries()):
    print(i, s)
print('arch/U after :', yellow_pieces(current_frame))
print('kh after:', kh(current_frame))
print('result:', last_action_result.get('board_changed'),'lvl=',last_action_result.get('level_completed'),'done=',last_action_result.get('done'),'reward=',last_action_result.get('reward'))

</function>
